verdict.oneLiner: A public Slack OAuth app can be registered, but it must go through a Marketplace review with enhanced scope checks and a 1‑to‑10‑week approval window.

steps.title: Gather required information and set up account
steps.detail: Ensure you have legal authority, a verified payment method, 2FA enabled on your Slack account, and have read Slack's terms. Prepare privacy policy and justification documents.

steps.title: Create a new Slack app in the developer portal
steps.detail: Sign in to https://api.slack.com/apps, click *Create New App*, choose *From scratch*, give the app a name and select your workspace.

steps.title: Configure OAuth & Permissions
steps.detail: In the app dashboard go to *OAuth & Permissions*. Add the redirect URI shown in the Composio Slack auth config (exact match required). Add required scopes (e.g., `chat:write`, `channels:history`). Save changes.

steps.title: Create Composio managed auth configuration
steps.detail: In the Composio dashboard select the Slack toolkit, click *Add New Auth Config*, paste the *Client ID* and *Client Secret* from the Slack app, and the exact redirect URI you entered in Slack. Save the config.

steps.title: Test the OAuth flow
steps.detail: Use a test user outside your organization to run the Composio‑generated auth URL, approve the scopes, and verify you receive an authorization code and access token. Fix any redirect‑URI mismatches (see f3).

steps.title: Submit app for public distribution review
steps.detail: In Slack app settings go to *App Management* → *Distribute App*. Choose *Public Distribution* (no marketplace listing). Fill justification, privacy‑policy checklist, and demo script. Submit for review.

steps.title: Await Slack review
steps.detail: Slack may take up to 10 days for initial feedback and up to 10 weeks for functional review.

steps.title: Enable production usage
steps.detail: After approval, mark the app as *Live* in the distribution page. Users outside your org can now install the app via the generated install URL.

whileYouWait.text: Continue using Composio’s managed auth for internal testing and keep test users active.
Monitor Slack review status; expect up to 10 days for initial feedback and up to 10 weeks for functional review.

gotchas.text: Redirect URI must match exactly; any deviation causes a 400 error.
Publicly distributed non‑Marketplace apps face stricter rate limits on conversation history endpoints.
Scopes that belong to higher‑risk families (e.g., `:history`, `admin.*`) trigger an enhanced review and may delay approval.

claims.text: A common pitfall is mismatched redirect URIs; Slack returns a 400 error when the redirect URL does not exactly match the one pre‑registered in the app settings.

claims.text: Each set of scopes must be requested in a separate OAuth flow and the redirect_uri parameter tells Slack where to send the authorization code.
